title: Florida Senate, District 24
what_it_does: Represents District 24 in the Florida Senate; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Ballotpedia lists incumbent Mack Bernard (D) running in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election; News Service of Florida reported Republican Jackie Green opened a campaign account to run against him in Palm Beach County's SD 24 (https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_State_Senate_District_24; https://www.newsserviceflorida.com/latest/briefs/bernard-draws-gop-challenger/article_d034427d-ffd7-4cdd-b253-0983d03348b8.html). Whether Green qualified could not be verified. Research limitation (Sept 2026): Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, dos.fl.gov, floridaelectionwatch.gov, Florida Politics and all news sites were blocked for fetching in this sandbox and the WebSearch budget was capped, so the roster is built only from search-result snippets; write-in/NPA qualifiers could not be checked. Positions are null because no snippet contained an explicit issue statement.

record.item: Voted for CS/HJR 1-F (2026), the June 2026 joint resolution that placed Amendment 3 on the ballot to raise the non-school homestead exemption to $250,000 by 2028 and let counties and cities exempt homesteads entirely; a vote to refer the amendment is coded as leaning.

Voted against SB 2-C (2025), the February 2025 special-session immigration law that created a State Board of Immigration Enforcement, made entering Florida as an unauthorized immigrant a state crime and required local cooperation with federal detention.
